path_conditions: called unconditionally at the start of wdt87xx_resume() — a PM resume callback
wdt87xx_resume is a SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS .resume handler, always called in process context (sleepable)
pattern_description: delay-gfp: mdelay() (busy-wait) called inside a function that is always invoked in a sleepable context (here a PM resume callback). mdelay holds the CPU spinning for the full delay; in sleepable context msleep() should be used instead so the scheduler can run other work.
